rationale: All 9 findings from code-review-final are resolved by the fix-up commit 8330f1e1d. The fix-up is defensive (adds atomic reservation, HTML/URL escaping, CR/LF stripping, task retention, broader exception catch, dedup-window clamp, invalid-duration skip); it introduces no new high-risk surface, so no blind+edge-case confirmation pass was run. Full test suite (143 tests) passes; ruff clean.

business_review.text: Budget owner can be selected from platform users (FE typeahead uses existing GET /v1/admin/users?search=)
business_review.evidence: Deferred to FE per spec; no backend user-picker needed.

business_review.text: Owner stored and returned through budget APIs
business_review.evidence: budget_router.py schemas + budget_service.py create/update + Budget model.

business_review.text: Owner can be updated by authorized user
business_review.evidence: PATCH accepts notification_owner_email; maintainer_access_only guard preserved.

business_review.text: When soft limit reached, owner notified
business_review.evidence: dependencies.py fires notify_soft_limit_reached in soft-limit branch after existing metric.
email_service.send_budget_soft_limit_notification subject + body include budget_name, budget_id, current_spend, soft_limit, admin link.

business_review.text: No owner → graceful fallback (metric still fires)
business_review.evidence: Notifier silently returns when email is None/empty; metric unaffected.
Hook added AFTER send_log_metric; broadened try/except only around loop scheduling.

business_review.text: Tests cover selection, update, notification, missing-owner
business_review.evidence: All original tests preserved; 5 new tests added for CR-002/003/004/005/009 coverage.

standards_review.notes: Ruff check + format clean on all changed files; full test suite passes.
HTML escape + CR/LF strip + URL encode applied to admin-controlled inputs — CR-003, CR-004 resolved.

finding_status.evidence: dependencies.py: `_pending_notify_tasks: set[asyncio.Task]` module-level set; `_pending_notify_tasks.add(task); task.add_done_callback(_pending_notify_tasks.discard)` retains a strong reference until the task completes.

budget_notification_service.py now calls `budget_repository.try_claim_soft_limit_notification(...)` (new method: conditional UPDATE with WHERE `soft_limit_notified_at IS NULL OR < threshold`). Only the caller whose UPDATE affects one row proceeds to send. Concurrent callers race safely at the DB level.

email_service.py: `import html`; `safe_name = html.escape(budget_name)`, `safe_id = html.escape(budget_id)`; HTML body interpolates `safe_name` / `safe_id` instead of raw values. Test `test_html_special_chars_in_budget_name_are_escaped` and `test_html_special_chars_in_budget_id_are_escaped` verify. URL path also uses `quote(budget_id, safe='')`.
email_service.py: `subject_name = budget_name.replace('\r', ' ').replace('\n', ' ')` before Subject interpolation. Test `test_crlf_in_budget_name_is_stripped_from_subject` verifies.

budget_notification_service.py: `_MAX_DEDUP_WINDOW = timedelta(hours=24)`; `_effective_dedup_window()` returns `min(parse_duration(raw), _MAX_DEDUP_WINDOW)`. Parametrized test `test_effective_dedup_window_clamps_at_24h` covers 60s / 12h / 24h / 25h / 30d cases. User approved the clamp approach explicitly.

The Python-side `(now - last)` subtraction was removed. Dedup comparison now happens server-side in Postgres via the conditional UPDATE — the DB drives timezone-aware comparison, eliminating the naive-datetime failure mode entirely.

dependencies.py: `except RuntimeError` → `except Exception as notify_exc`. Any cross-loop error (RuntimeError from SQLAlchemy AsyncEngine attached to different loop, or any other dispatch failure) is now swallowed silently and logged; the metric emission remains unaffected.

budget_notification_service.py: reserve-first-then-send order — `try_claim_soft_limit_notification` + `session.commit()` complete BEFORE `email_service.send_budget_soft_limit_notification(...)` is called. On SMTP failure the reservation is already durable, so no duplicate email on retry.

budget_notification_service.py: `if window is None: logger.warning(...); return`. Test `test_skips_when_budget_duration_is_invalid` verifies that a malformed `budget_duration` causes the notifier to skip both the claim and the send (rather than notify on every request).
